name: supply-chain-management
description: Multi-store supply chain management — API and web app in one deployable unit

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run build && node scripts/copy-client.mjs
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend exec tsc -b --noEmit
